title: authz folder search decodes both RESOURCE_TABLE and FIELD_VALUES formats
answers: Why does the folder tree break when querying unified storage field values?
How to add/change the authz folder search request without breaking old servers
Folder search returns wrong parent UIDs or empty tree after unified storage change
body:
Symptom: authz folder-tree loading from unified storage returns empty/incorrect parent relationships after changing the search request's ResultFormat or Fields.
Root cause: the response decoder in pkg/services/authz/rbac/store/folder_store.go (listFoldersViaSearch) must branch on the ACTUAL ResultFormat the server returned (resp.ResultFormat), not assume it matches what was requested, because older servers still reply with RESOURCE_TABLE even when FIELD_VALUES is requested.
Fix pattern: when requesting resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with a specific ResultFormat (e.g. FIELD_VALUES) and a narrowed Fields list, keep/add a decode path for every ResultFormat the server could legally send, and select the decode path from the response, not the request.
Constraints: applies to any caller of ResourceSearch that sets ResultFormat or Fields for efficiency; does not apply if the caller only ever talks to a pinned server version where compatibility isn't a concern.
applies: pkg/services/authz/rbac/store/folder_store.go and any other ResourceSearch caller that sets ResultFormat/Fields on resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest
